title: DumpstarFire Skylands
description: Banish The Bedrock Border And Shatter Your World Throughout The Sky!
body:
This datapack turns the overworld and nether into shattered skylands of chaos! This pack also expands the nether height to be the same as the overworld! Also when falling into the void in the overworld and nether you will loop back up to the top of the dimension!

### Important
This datapack modifies world generation and the dimension size of the nether! If this pack is removed from a world then it will no longer be able to be loaded!
